reason: A DeepSeek Harness project file explorer that provides a docked workspace file tree, in-app previews for common file and media types, and related installation patches.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跟随工作区的项目文件树，并支持在界面中预览代码、文本、图片、音视频和 PDF 文件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness project file explorer that follows the active workspace and previews code, text, images, audio, video, and PDF files in the interface.

capabilities: Lists and reads files from the current project workspace
Previews code, text, images, audio, video, and PDF files in the interface
Opens the current folder in the system file manager
Modifies DeepSeek Harness installation files through install and patch scripts
Provides deletion and archiving actions for ungrouped sessions
